items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: They were "Blue Lou" and a lot of other things and later things. He had made "Stompin At The Savoy" some time ago.

ctx.x: Sampson was a good writer. He's a good arranger, he's a good composer. He had the book there on a lot of Edgar Sampson things.
They were "Blue Lou" and a lot of other things and later things. He had made "Stompin At The Savoy" some time ago.
They probably had been playing it, you know. Because Sampson had made about eight or nine things in the book, you know.
